title: How To Inject Zepbound
hook: Here's how to inject Zepbound with a needle, step by step. It takes about 10 seconds once you know what you're doing.
body:
Inject into your thigh on the outer front part, right around the middle. Not the inside of your leg, not down by your knee. Pinch the fat: this is a subcutaneous injection, so it goes into fat, not muscle. Stick the needle in, not too deep. Inject slowly. Do not slam it in. Wait one second after it's all gone, then withdraw. A good stick is nearly painless and there is no blood. If you bled or it hurt, you went too deep, you were in the wrong spot, or you pushed the plunger too fast.

Not medical advice. Talk to your doctor.
